info.name: README Extended (Beta)
info.summary: Beta — Native header and footer markdown zones for the Nextcloud files app.
info.description:
**⚠️ Beta release — use with care and report issues.**
Adds configurable markdown header and footer zones to folder views in Nextcloud Files.
## What it does
- 🟢 Renders a configurable markdown **header** and **footer** zone in every folder view of the Files app. - 📝 Native text-editor integration with a preview fallback, so the zones are edited in place like any other markdown file. - 🔗 Works for both **private files** and **public shares**. - 🗂 Per-zone basename priority — pick which file name wins for each zone. - 🧩 Template variables using `{{...}}` for dynamic content. - 🧮 Mermaid, KaTeX and syntax highlighting in private mode. - ⚙️ Dedicated admin settings page for filenames, zone heights, visibility and global-footer behaviour.
## Admin setup
Settings → Administration → README Extended → configure zone filenames and behaviour → Save.
